entry_item.definition: 1 - TEI [cf. tu / ty] Suffix of the comitative with the following functions: a) It expresses the idea of "together with, in company with" b) It expresses possession, association, or connection with, or means "characterized or qualified by," etc. It is used both attributively and predicatively. In attributive position it is interchangeable with tu/ ty. c) By extension it shows that something is within a container (interchangeable with tu/ty). d) Expresses age after numerals.
